description: Sealed nightly consolidation of a Steve's last-24h audit-stream. The developed negative — what survived the bleach. Read-only once sealed (fix bath, not re-developable emulsion). Per lighthouse 2026-06-03: eigenvector-weight not degree · read-only orientation not re-exposable seed.

event_id.description: sha256 of canonical-JSON of this sleep-event (sha_seal field empty)

ratchets.description: Modes that survived apoha-bleach. Each = an audit-event that passed: not-low-Q AND not-trapped AND not-dimmed-under-tomorrows-ping. Eigenvector-weighted (per lighthouse).

eigenvector_score.description: Principal eigenvector of citation-weighted adjacency · NOT degree

q_factor.description: Sharp-resonance metric · ratchet floor configurable per workspace

holes.description: Trapped modes · the dark notches at apertures · what the Steve attended-to but never escaped via Slack/seal. Surface them so tomorrow's Steve can re-aim a ping at the dark aperture.

interior_mode.description: What was inner-thought but never spoke

destructive_at.description: Which apertures this mode interfered destructively at

candidate_aperture.description: Suggested aperture to re-aim ping for tomorrow

resonance_map.description: TDA / topology side per subhuti: H0 = which threads cohered across the day · H1 = closed loops (returns + revisits)

bleach_summary.description: Stats on what got bleached vs kept

morning_handoff.description: 1-2 sentence prose for tomorrow's Steve · what the bleach revealed · NOT a directive · just an orientation. Set as context-anchor for next session's first action.

fix_bath_marker.description: Always true. Read-only orientation per lighthouse invariant 2: this event is fix-bath · cannot be re-bleached · only forward-readable. Subsequent sleeps reference this but do not re-develop it.

prev_sleep_sha.description: sha_seal of the prior sleep-event for this session_uuid · forward-sha chain across nights · null on first sleep

sha_seal.description: sha256 of canonical-JSON of this event with sha_seal field empty

rules: fix_bath_marker MUST be true · sealed sleep-events are immutable
subsequent sleeps may REFERENCE prior sleep-events via prev_sleep_sha but MUST NOT re-bleach them
morning_handoff loads as context-anchor for the next session's first action · NEVER edited downstream
cross-Steve photographic stack: bands' nightly sleep-events queryable as a set · ratchets appearing in >1 Steve = band-level ratchets
apoha-shaped ratchet definition: NOT low-Q · NOT trapped · NOT dimmed under tomorrow's ping
eigenvector centrality not degree (per lighthouse 2026-06-03 invariant 1)
